svg.title: SIGMIDI Left enclosure cable bundle layout
svg.desc: Top-down routing proposal using native component footprints, color coded by cable purpose. Rear edge at top. Main case 350 by 92 millimetres. Base-removal connectors and a modular four-net interface are shown.
svg.text: Top view, roof omitted · actual CAD footprints · proposed routing, disconnects and interface area
PREVIEW / NOT A CUTTING OR PINOUT TEMPLATE

svg.text: REAR ↑ / FRONT ↓ · Looking down into the case, not a mirrored underside view
TAIL + GND + optional 5V + LED DATA. Each pair adds 2 × 1 kΩ; final TAIL stays open.

g.text: Pololu VOUT → DFRobot VIN / LED rail
Common reference; LED return to supply
Dark lines beside power and signals
Series taps T1–T10; each adds 1 kΩ

svg.text: Lines represent bundle corridors, not electrical junctions. Connect ladder taps and pixels in the stated order.
Power/LED reference corridors come from Fusion. Components at different heights overlap in projection.
Other routes, carrier and connectors are proposals; verify vertical transitions, fasteners and base clearance.
Routing proposal. Dashed interface is not a fitted CAD part; vertical clearances require review.
